title: Northgate Purchases & Returns Channel Terms: Cancellation Cutoffs and Club Pickup Holds
content:
These channel terms of Northgate Purchases & Returns set, for each purchase channel, whether member services may cancel an order before it is fulfilled, how many calendar days after the order date that remains possible, how long a club pickup order is held once it is ready, and whether someone the member names may collect it.

| Channel | Member services may cancel before fulfilment | Cancellation cutoff (calendar days after the order date) | Club pickup hold (calendar days) | Person named by the member may collect with photo ID |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | no | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | yes | 0 (cancellable until fulfilled) | 3 | yes |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | no | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | yes | 1 | 0 | no |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | yes | 1 | 0 | no |
| Northgate Special Order | yes | 2 | 0 | no |

## Desk notes on the table

- A cutoff of **0** on a channel that allows cancellation means the order can be cancelled at any time until it is fulfilled; this is the case for the Northgate Club Pickup Order. On the Northgate In-Club Purchase and the Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order the cutoff column is 0 but member services does not cancel at all, because cancellation is not allowed on those channels.
- A non-zero cutoff (1 day for the Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order and the Northgate Business Delivery Order, 2 days for the Northgate Special Order) is counted in calendar days after the order date.
- The pickup hold applies only to the Northgate Club Pickup Order (3 calendar days); a hold of 0 means the term is not applicable to the channel.
- Alternate pickup by a named person with photo ID is available only on the Northgate Club Pickup Order.
